column1: # Chunk registry for NFS Undercover (STREAML8R_MW2.BUN). Same columns as chunk_registry.tsv.
# Use: python common/chunk_registry.py STREAML8R_MW2.BUN --kind stream --registry common/registry/undercover.tsv
# Populated from the chunk_probe_all output of STREAML8R_MW2.BUN and the readers in NFS-ModTools (test branch).
# status: done | partial | scan-only | unread | set-aside | out-of-scope. Carbon statuses are NOT carried over: a row is partial/done only where a UC reader reads it.
# tool: the reader that handles the chunk (AssetDumper class or stream python tool). Names come from AssetDumper, ChunkView/ChunkDef.txt or the probe.
# Names and layouts marked UCGT come from github.com/NI240SX/UCGT (bChunkID.java, BlockType.java, streamEditor/streamBlocks); they are hints, the real hex decides.
